draft.shortGloss: to hurt; to be ill; to root for
draft.emotion: dull and persistent, feeling worn down by physical discomfort
notes: This verb has two different conjugations depending on meaning. For 'to hurt' (sense 1), use 3rd person forms болит (singular) and болят (plural) with у + genitive for the person: у меня болит голова.
For 'to be ill' (sense 2, takes instrumental for the illness) and 'to root for' (sense 3, takes за + accusative), conjugate as: я болею, ты болеешь, они болеют.
